notes.title: Deathlike: Awakening is Out!
notes.content:
[b]Full version of Deathlike: Awakening is now available![/b]
[u]Things changed[/u]:[list][*]Graphics improved
[*] Demon mechanics reworked and AI improved, gameplay is even more scary now
[*] demon appearance improved, new model, effects and animations
[*] added new immersive menu
[*] new location - church
[*] performance optimization, better scene loading
[/list]
